headline: Petróleo sube; ataques a buques en Oriente Medio contrarrestan perspectivas de exceso de oferta
summary: Oil prices edged higher after falling the previous day, as supply concerns from the Middle East counteracted expectations of a market surplus.
why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, and supply disruptions in the Middle East, a key producing region, directly affect energy costs and inflation expectations.
why_moved: Attacks on ships in the Middle East raised supply concerns, offsetting expectations of excess oil supply in the market.
